_note: Day-1 task from .claude/skills/cloudflare-clef/SKILL.md: a REAL Clef response, captured 2026-10-07 against @cf/cloudflare/clef-flash. Used to pin the request/response shape in apps/worker/src/clef.ts. Synthetic demo data (Pixel & Pine Studio).
transport: REST POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$ACCOUNT/ai/run/@cf/cloudflare/clef-flash (the Worker binding returns the same `result` object)

account.instructions: Which GL account should the gross amount classify to?

needs_review.instructions: Should a human review this first?

risk.instructions: Risk of fraud, dispute or chargeback.

shape_notes: The binding (env.AI.run) resolves to `result` directly, so code reads `out.answers`, not `out.result.answers`.
`needs_review.noul` is a probability of YES (number), not a boolean.
`risk.score` is the probability-weighted index over the ordered `criteria`; `probabilities`/`legend` are extra and unused by the gate.

The request body's `model` field must match the URL model: body `clef-flash` with `/clef-flash`, body `clef` with `/clef`. Sending `clef-flash` to the `/clef` endpoint returns 422 "Unsupported model 'clef-flash'. Use 'clef'".

Gotcha that cost an afternoon: detaching the binding (`const run = env.AI.run; run(...)`) throws "Cannot set properties of undefined (setting '#options')" and silently routes EVERY decision to review. Always call it as a method on the binding object (`env.AI.run(...)`) so it keeps its `this`.
